necessity_paragraph: The claim for CPT 93229 was denied under code PR-204, but the service is medically necessary for the patient's diagnosis codes I47.1 and G45.9. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy.
